resources.string: NotiMate is being built to turn selected Android notifications into private, reviewable proposals. Start by learning about access and your choices.
Your notifications stay on this device

Notification analysis is designed to happen on this device. Raw notification content is not uploaded or saved. NotiMate can use only notification content and context supplied by the source app, not its full conversation history. External actions require your confirmation.
Saved proposals and activity stay on this device. No account is required.

Android Notification Access lets NotiMate receive notifications from other apps. NotiMate processes only sources you select. You can pause processing or revoke access in Android settings at any time. The next screen belongs to Android.
Access is not enabled. You can continue to an inactive Today screen.
Notification Access was revoked. Saved proposals remain available; no new notifications can be analyzed.
Proposal alerts let NotiMate show its own notifications. This is separate from receiving other apps’ notifications. Saved proposals remain available here if alerts are off.
Automatic proposal alerts are not available in this build, even when notification permission is allowed.
